links.comparator_used: Prior published results for GPT-4o without domain context (63.1%); a different, older model, so not a same-model comparison
links.outcome: Accuracy on the 168-question 2023 ASNC Board Preparation Exam
links.effect: Claude Opus 4.7 with RAG 86.3% ± 1.4% (text 88.8%, image 73.3%); GPT-5.5 with RAG 86.7% ± 2.2% (text 88.5%, image 77.0%); vs GPT-4o without context 63.1%, a 23-percentage-point improvement; both exceeded the human FIT mean of 78.0%
links.tradeoff: GPT-5.5 refused a mean of 12.2 questions (7.3%) per iteration due to safety filters. The gain also reflects the model upgrade over 18 months, so RAG is not isolated from model generation.
links.quote: Compared to GPT-4o without context (63.1%), this represents a 23-percentage-point improvement in 18 months.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with domain textbook and guidelines
